intuition: Process denominations one at a time so each partial count represents combinations, not orderings.

brute_force.approach: Recursively choose how many coins of each denomination contribute to the amount.

optimal.approach: Use a one-dimensional ways table; iterate totals upward so the current coin can be reused, with coins as the outer loop to avoid permutation duplicates.

edge_cases: Amount zero has one combination: choose no coins.
An unreachable positive amount has zero combinations.
